company.title: Fill in your company profile
company.text: Candidates decide whether to accept an invitation by who sends it. Without a company profile you cannot invite, publish vacancies or tasks.

needs.title: Needs
needs.emptyTitle: Describe who you are looking for
needs.emptyText: A need sets the category, the stack and topic importance. The shortlist is built from it and explains every place.

activity.title: Activity
activity.emptyText: Sent invitations and applications to your vacancies will show up here.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.emptyText: Applications are handled, conversations are read, task answers are graded.

hero.title: Describe who you are looking for
hero.lead: Paste a job post or write a few lines. We turn it into a draft with specialization, grade, stack and salary range, then build a selection from it.

invitations.title: Invitations and applications
invitations.lead: Invitations you sent to candidates and applications to your vacancies.
invitations.budgetHint: Applications to vacancies do not use the invitation budget.
invitations.emptyText: Invite a candidate from a need's shortlist or from their card.
invitations.pickText: Sent invitations are listed on the left. Open one to see its terms, deadlines and conversation.
invitations.missingText: The link may be outdated. Pick an invitation from the list.

detail.title: Invitation to candidate {{tag}}
detail.revokedText: Since {{date}} the card is anonymous again. The conversation goes on.
detail.waiting: Awaiting a reply until {{date}}, Moscow time
detail.oneOpen: Until the candidate replies, you cannot send them a second invitation.
